pregame.pressurePoint: Jets pass game vs Patriots pass defense. The Patriots are No. 8 of 32 at limiting explosive passes (1.25) and No. 7 in pass success allowed (42%). The Jets rank No. 25 in pass explosiveness (1.22) and No. 16 in pass success rate (47%). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. The Patriots keep the lid on. The Jets should expect to drive the long way. Watch the longest Jets completion. If it is under 25 yards at the half, the Patriots have won the matchup.
